job.title: Storekeeping Assistant
job.description:
We are hiring a Storekeeping Assistant for a production company in Kuje, Abuja.

Responsibilities

  • Receive, check and record incoming materials and finished goods.
  • Issue items to production staff and keep accurate stock records.
  • Keep the store clean, organised and secure, and report any shortages.

Requirements

  • Minimum of OND or HND
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Accommodation available.
  • Hands-on experience in a production company.
  • Other statutory benefits.
